$Comment: Crack Cursed Geodes during one season, counted by USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Crack. The description's number comes from the criterion's Amount through @amount. Each year's copy pays MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row once, Mining XP, the skill the geodes turn up with, in Claim: it waits on the achievements page until the player collects it, as every achievement reward does but a title or a token. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown.
